specialEffects.description: Shadowveil: When the wearer’s health drops below 25%, the cloak grants 3 seconds of invisibility and 5% movement speed. Triggers once every 30 seconds.
When standing still, recover 1 health every 2 seconds.
Reduces the attacker's movement speed by -5% for 2 seconds when hit by a melee attack.
Deals an additional 15 ice magical damage and inflicts wet for 3 seconds on hit. Wet: The target loses -20% movement speed and jump height is reduced by 30%.
Hitting a target heals you for 0.2% of the damage dealt, and inflicts a Bleed that deals 30 physical damage for 5 seconds.

Upon hitting a target or object, the blade violently shatters. If the blade hits a target, shatter will deal up to an additional 25 ice magical damage. The broken blade regenerates to its original state over 4 seconds, reducing shatter damage until the blade is fully reformed.
When you hit an enemy, deal an additional 12 magical damage and burn the target over 9 seconds. Burn: The target takes 27 fire magical damage.
Deal 20 magical damage true to the target and cause the target to only hear their own screams for 3 seconds.
Gain 25% action speed and fire arrows that fly in a straight line.
When you deal damage to a target, render them unable to receive incoming healing for 20 seconds.
Gain 10% action speed. When you hit an enemy, cause a thunderbolt dealing 20 magical damage.
A successful spell cast makes the user invisible for 4 seconds and leaves the user's illusion temporarily.
Gain +15 magical damage.
Gain +15 magical damage.

When swung, the weapon emits waves that follow its trajectory. These waves inflict the wet status on targets for 2 seconds, deal 15 water magical damage to enemies, and restore 10 health to allies over 3 seconds. Wet: The target loses -20% movement speed and jump height is reduced by 30%.
When receiving a killing blow, the wielder becomes invincible and remains at 1 Health for 3 seconds. This effect can only be triggered once during an adventure. Does not trigger while on cooldown.
Hitting a target inflicts a 3 seconds drunken state.
Gain physical damage weapon primary and push the hit target back.
When you deal damage to an enemy, inflict disease dealing 15 magical damage true for 4 seconds.
When you deal damage to an enemy, crush their armor, reducing their physical reduction by -25% for 10 seconds. This effect stacks up to 3 times.
When you land a melee hit on a player, instantly teleport behind them by stepping into their shadow. Can only trigger once every 3 seconds.
When casting a healing spell, summons a giant rat to fight with you for 20 seconds.
Each time you deal damage, absorb the targets soul and gain 5 strength base, 5 vigor base for 60 seconds. This effect stacks up to 3 times.
Restore spell memory per hit when attacking.
Successfully casting a spell increases your casting speed by 10%, up to 5 times. The effect lasts for 20 seconds and is reset each time it increases.

When you deal damage to a target, gain 1% chance to emit a poison cloud for seconds, dealing 15 magical damage every second to enemies within its area. Up to poison clouds can exist at a time and the wielder is immune to damage from poison clouds.
Additional 1 #. Physical damage reduction increases by 15%, and Magical damage reduction increases by 15%. Grants immunity to knockback. Additionally, durability is doubled when deployed.
Attacking enemies with this weapon deals an additional 10 magical damage, inflicting frostbite for 2 seconds. Frostbite: The target loses -20% movement speed and -20% action speed.
When you swing, winds are emitted according to the trajectory you swing. The released wind deals 15 air magical damage to targets and knocks them back.
While in defensive stance, gain the ability to deflect incoming projectile spells. When a project is reflected, the effect continues for 8 seconds. You may not reflect spells again for 12 seconds.
Dealing physical damage to an enemy heals you for 1 #.
When you deal damage to a target, cause a death flower to bloom. After 3 have bloomed, the death blossoms explode, dealing 30 magical damage true.
When held in hand, maximum health is reduced by -5%, but regenerates 2 health per second.
Gain 1 impact resistance. Blocking a melee attack deals 0.4% of the damage blocked to the opponent.
Returns 5 physical damage true to the attacker on blocking an attack.
